---
title: "Stim Artifact Removal Report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: true
    toc_depth: 3
    df_print: kable
    theme: spacelab
params:
  recording_block: ~
  time_range: ~
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = NA,
  rows.print = 10, fig.width = 12
)

pipeline <- ravepipeline::pipeline_from_path(".")

# Bring settings + shared-*.R functions (plots, helpers) into scope
shared_env <- pipeline$shared_env()
settings <- pipeline$get_settings()
list2env(settings, envir = globalenv())
list2env(as.list(shared_env), envir = globalenv())

# Run / read the required targets
pipeline$run(
  scheduler = "none", type = "smart", return_values = FALSE,
  names = c("subject", "loaded_signals", "aligned_pulse_list",
            "snippet_list", "template_list", "cleaned_signals")
)

subject         <- pipeline$read("subject")
loaded_signals  <- pipeline$read("loaded_signals")
snippet_list    <- pipeline$read("snippet_list")
template_list   <- pipeline$read("template_list")
cleaned_signals <- pipeline$read("cleaned_signals")

all_blocks <- names(loaded_signals)
report_block <- params$recording_block
if (!length(report_block) || is.na(report_block) || !report_block %in% all_blocks) {
  report_block <- all_blocks[[1]]
}

time_range <- params$time_range
if (length(time_range) != 2 || all(is.na(time_range))) {
  time_range <- c(NA, NA)
}

snip <- snippet_list[[report_block]]
tmpl <- template_list[[report_block]]
```

Subject: **`r subject$subject_id`** &middot; block: **`r report_block`**
&middot; detection: **`r detection_source`**

## Aligned pulses & estimated template

```{r snippets, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
if (is.list(snip) && ncol(snip$snips) > 0) {
  template_full <- if (is.list(tmpl)) tmpl$template$template_full else NULL
  plot_pulse_snippets_overlay(
    snips = snip$snips, sample_rate = snip$sample_rate,
    pre = snip$pre, template_full = template_full)
} else {
  plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No aligned pulses for this block")
}
```

```{r template, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
if (is.list(tmpl)) {
  plot_template_waveform(
    template_full = tmpl$template$template_full,
    sample_rate = tmpl$sample_rate,
    blank_width = length(tmpl$template$blank_rows),
    pre = tmpl$pre)
} else {
  plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No template estimated for this block")
}
```

## Pulse PCA scores

```{r pca, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (is.list(tmpl) && is.list(tmpl$pca)) {
  plot_pca_scatter(tmpl$pca)
} else {
  plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "PCA not available")
}
```

## Original vs cleaned

```{r before_after, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
raw_arr <- loaded_signals[[report_block]]$`@impl`
cln_arr <- cleaned_signals[[report_block]]$`@impl`
raw <- raw_arr[drop = TRUE, dimnames = FALSE]
cln <- cln_arr[drop = TRUE, dimnames = FALSE]
sample_rate <- cln_arr$get_header("sample_rate")
plot_before_after(raw, cln, sample_rate = sample_rate, time_range = time_range)
```
